description.value:
You can now fuel your tech powers with focus points, lowering your maximum focus points by 1 until your next long rest whenever you do so.

In addition, using a Focus feature can trigger one of the following tech enhancements, each costing 1 tech point:

Flurry of Blows. A hit scored during your Flurry of Blows deals an extra 1d8 damage of the same type.

Patient Defense. While Patient Defense is active, being hit by an attack lets you use your reaction to roll your Martial Arts die and add it to your AC against that attack.

Step of the Wind. While Step of the Wind is active, you become immune to the shocked condition, and each slowed level you suffer reduces your speed by only 5 feet instead of the normal amount, unless doing so would bring it to 0.
